Other transitively imported modules — including any prelude — are pulled in via the import branch of exec-flow-compilation.
The REPL never references the prelude directly.)

eval internals (per pipeline-v4 §6.2 + Decision 44 amended FIXME 0167 + 2026-05-13 third amendment) —

parse src, classify each form, route through CompilerSession::process_cluster (the SAME shared orchestrator used by the compilation worker — see exec-flow-compilation typecheck-phase cluster body and facades/int.md "process_cluster — the cluster-atomic orchestration loop").

A non-(begin) REPL input becomes a one-form cluster (per FIXME 0165 — non-(begin)-grouped REPL inputs are processed as single-form clusters, cross-input forward references are NOT supported). A (begin form₁ ... formN) input is the explicit multi-form cluster boundary — eval unwraps the top-level begin and passes the inner forms to process_cluster.

process_cluster constructs SymbolTableAccess::Cluster with modules + staging (&mut empty_staging) + current_module, and threads &mut ctx through a single cranelisp_typecheck::check_forms call. Typecheck mutates staging via ctx.current_symbol_table_mut — the same accessor used in committed-mode. check_forms internally drives Pass 1 then Pass 2 across all parsed entries — the two-pass discipline lives inside check_forms's frame. process_cluster catches CheckError::Gap returns and dispatches via handle_gap (register + wait_for_typecheck_symbol + (priority_boost + wait_for_inmem) + wait_for_typecheck_type as needed), retrying until macro expansion and check_forms succeed.

S76 W-Macro DECISION LOCKED — macro expansion is PASS 1 (int's process_cluster expand loop, where typecheck recognises, MacroExpander executes, and dependency forms compile just-in-time), running BEFORE check_forms. check_forms is PASSES 2 and 3 over the fully-expanded non-macro forms (the "Pass 1 then Pass 2" phrasing here denotes check_forms's internal two passes, i.e. module Passes 2 and 3). The retired frontend ExpansionError gap path is gone — recognition is typecheck's, execution is int's MacroExpander. See exec-flow-compilation and macro-availability-model.md section 0.

For definition clusters, eval follows up with insert_cluster to drain staging atomically into current_repl_module's live SymbolTable — Decision 44 — staging dissolves with the function frame on any failure, drains atomically on success.
For the trailing expression, eval skips insert_cluster — the temp closure has no module commit — and hands the typed AST to a fresh per-eval JITModule.

shared entry point — invokes the same expand → build_form → single check_forms call (internal Pass 1 then Pass 2) sequence shown in exec-flow-compilation typecheck-phase cluster body — S66 FIXME 0156 build_form returns Vec[ParsedEntry] — Decision 44 amended FIXME 0167 + 2026-05-13 third amendment: typecheck is a single cranelisp_typecheck::check_forms(Vec[ParsedEntry], &mut SymbolTableAccess, &SymbolTables) -> Result[(), CheckError] call — including the gap-orchestration retry loop (whole-cluster retry against fresh staging) for any FQ refs the input touches. scope = current_repl_module supplies typecheck visibility (locals + imports + private symbols). No live commit yet — staging held under &mut borrow inside SymbolTableAccess::Cluster carries the cluster's entries.
cluster-atomic commit — drains staging into ST_current via SymbolTable::insert_or_update per entry.
Triggers any pending typecheck waiters and (for entries that need_codegen) enqueues per-symbol Jit work items.
per-symbol wait — block only on the new symbol's jit, not on every pending in-mem item (global wait already happened at STEP 4)
[needs_codegen]

for defn redefinition — per-symbol reclaim of old Arc<Jit> when previous ModuleEntry's Code is dropped (Decision 41 reclaim semantics — D31 retired — substance amended into D41 at S64 + relocated at S69 Phase 3)

[one or more definition forms (defn / defmacro / deftype / deftrait / impl / import / mod / platform / def) — wrapped as a one-form cluster, or unwrapped from (begin ...) as an explicit multi-form cluster]
same shared entry point and same gap-orchestration retry loop — FQ refs in the expression are resolved by process_form before it returns.
scope = current_repl_module for visibility, no commit target.
The wrapped expression is "(defn __expr [] expr)" but __expr is NOT committed anywhere — no insert_symbol call follows.
The temp closure exists only as a typed AST + per-eval JIT until the trampoline returns and the JIT drops.
enqueues BlockingJitCodegen for dep (priority-boosted) and waits — see exec-flow-compilation.

S76 W-Macro DECISION LOCKED — the macro-clause use of block_for_macro_codegen is DELETED (no same-module non-macro clause callee under the lock — macro-availability-model.md section 0.7). This eval-time value-expression dependency-codegen wait is an int-interior scheduler concern, re-synced when /dev lands the three-pass implementation.
[each un-codegenned dependency dep: FQSymbol in callees]
per pipeline-v4 §6.2 — fresh JITModule per eval call.
Wrapped in Jit newtype whose Drop calls unsafe JITModule::free_memory() (per Decision 41 §"Cranelift evidence" — D31 retired — substance amended into D41 at S64 + relocated at S69 Phase 3).
Temp closure has NO entry in ST_current and NO GOT slot — it is one-shot.

Per Decision 41 (+ S75 W2 Finding-A) backend writes ONLY the GOT slot via got().store_slot(slot, ptr) for entried symbols — the CALLER composes Code::Jit(Arc[Jit]) after the call (int wraps Arc::new(jit) — backend only borrows &mut M, never owns the Arc[Jit]). For the temp-closure case there is no entry / no GOT slot — int reads code_ptr from the populated Jit handle directly, and no Code is composed.
runtime cadence active inside the call —
atomic RC inc/dec, fork-join cells (lenient eval / par bind!),
IO trampoline if expected_type wraps IO _ (see exec-flow-runtime)
drop(Jit) — custom Drop calls unsafe JITModule::free_memory() —
__expr's executable memory is reclaimed before the next iteration
(safety holds because the value is fully consumed, GOT was never updated, and fn values are heap closures that go through GOTs not raw ptrs)
[trailing expression form (e.g. "(+ 1 2)" or "factorial 10")]
formats per repl/spec.md §1 — ":Type value — classification — docstring" for definitions, bare ":Type value" for expressions, etc.
per repl/spec.md §15 — persists current_repl_module's accumulated forms to {project_root}/{current_repl_module}.cl
[result is a definition or structural change]
[CommandResult::Nothing]

(imports during eval may have registered new modules — the watcher should now watch their files too)
STEP 7 — print next prompt with timing info from the just-completed iteration
[until /quit or EOF]
SHUTDOWN — on /quit or EOF
ensures cache .o + sidecars are written for all touched modules — next REPL session can cache-hit
signals worker pools to drain + terminate —
closes watcher channel — closes cache directory.
drop(Sess) — per-symbol reclaim chain fires (Decision 41) —
each ModuleEntry::Code drops, Arc<Jit> refcount hits 0,
custom Drop calls unsafe JITModule::free_memory() per symbol (one JITModule per defn under D41 cardinality).
